query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (indexer_address, snapshot_at::date) indexer_address AS "indexer_address!", snapshot_at::date AS "snapshot_date!", delegation_exchange_rate::float8 AS "rate!" FROM indexer_snapshots WHERE indexer_address = ANY($1) AND snapshot_at >= $2 AND delegation_exchange_rate IS NOT NULL ORDER BY indexer_address, snapshot_at::date, snapshot_at DESC
